product_overview: A hybrid Web and Desktop application for visualizing and analyzing chemical equipment parameters from uploaded CSV files, using a shared Django backend API to provide data summaries, historical data management, and interactive charts.
core_goals: Provide seamless CSV upload on both Web and Desktop platforms.
Display equipment data with summaries including counts, averages, and type distribution.
Persist last 5 uploaded datasets and display history with details.
Enable visualization of equipment metrics via charts using Chart.js (Web) and Matplotlib (Desktop).
Integrate secure user authentication and session management.
Generate downloadable PDF reports from dataset analyses.
key_features: CSV Upload capability supporting chemical equipment datasets with specific parameters such as Equipment Name, Type, Flowrate, Pressure, Temperature.
Data Summary API delivering total counts, average values of parameters, and equipment type distributions, accessible from both frontends.
Visual display of data using tables and charts (Type distribution, metrics) on Web using React and Chart.js, and on Desktop using PyQt5 and Matplotlib.
History Management UI to view the last 5 uploaded datasets and their summaries.
User Authentication form with login and registration toggles, token-based session persistence, and logout functionality.
Dashboard with metric summary cards, history listing, and interactive charts reflecting API data.
PDF report generation feature for exporting dataset analyses.
user_flow_summary: User signs in via the Authentication Form, obtaining an access token for session.
User navigates to the CSV Upload Panel to select and upload a dataset file.
The backend processes the CSV, updates the dataset history, and provides summary metrics via the API.
User views the Dashboard displaying summary cards, a history table of recent uploads, and charts representing data distributions.
User can access detailed views of specific datasets and trigger PDF report generation.
User logs out via the Navigation Bar, ending the session securely.
validation_criteria: Successful upload and processing of CSV datasets on both Web and Desktop interfaces.
Accurate display of summary statistics and chart visualizations matching backend data.
History accurately reflects the last 5 uploaded datasets with correct details.
Authentication processes correctly issue, validate, and revoke access tokens.
UI elements respond appropriately to user input and navigation, including active link highlighting and logout.
PDF reports generate correctly with data from selected datasets without errors.

features.name: Application Shell & Routing
features.description: Sets up the React Router structure with protected routes, guards, and page-level components for dashboard, upload, history, and dataset detail flows.

features.name: Navigation Bar
features.description: Top navigation with active link highlighting and logout handling for authenticated sessions.

features.name: Authentication Form
features.description: Login/Register toggle form that calls API auth endpoints and persists tokens.

features.name: Dataset Upload Panel
features.description: CSV upload workflow with status messaging and callback when a dataset is created.

features.name: Dashboard Metrics
features.description: Summary cards, history table, and type distribution chart rendering using API metrics and Chart.js.

features.name: API Service Layer
features.description: Axios instance with interceptors and typed helpers for authentication, datasets, metrics, and reports.

features.name: Global Styles
features.description: Shared styling definitions and responsive layout rules for panels, grids, and typography.
